missing_implementations.title: Typed Template DSL — IPromptTemplate interface not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: IPromptTemplate interface with compiled DSL support (slots, conditionals, loops), typed TemplateContext, validate() without rendering
missing_implementations.observed: Implemented: PromptTemplateCompiler (recursive-descent parser), IPromptTemplate interface, CompiledPromptTemplate (slots/conditionals/loops), SlotType enum, PromptContextValue typed context, PromptTemplateValidator (nlohmann/json). 30 tests in tests/test_prompt_template_compiler.cpp (PromptTemplateCompilerFocusedTests).
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [prompt_engineering] Implement typed DSL for PromptTemplate with slot/conditional/loop support

missing_implementations.title: Context Window Budget Manager — IRAGContextBudgetManager not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: IRAGContextBudgetManager with allocate(tokens), remaining(), BudgetExhaustedError; strict token-limit enforcement before LLM dispatch
missing_implementations.observed: RAGPromptBuilder::selectChunks() implements character-based budget (not token-based); no IRAGContextBudgetManager; no token counter; no BudgetExhaustedError exception
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [prompt_engineering] Implement IRAGContextBudgetManager with hard token-limit enforcement

missing_implementations.title: Chain-of-Thought Execution Tracer — IChainOfThoughtTracer not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: IChainOfThoughtTracer with noexcept callbacks onStepBegin(StepId), onStepEnd(StepId, reasoning, duration); ChainOfThoughtBuilder::attachTracer()
missing_implementations.observed: ChainOfThoughtBuilder is a pure string assembler; no tracer interface; no callback mechanism; no per-step latency attribution
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [prompt_engineering] Implement IChainOfThoughtTracer for per-step reasoning instrumentation

missing_implementations.title: Typed A/B Experimentation Framework — IPromptABFramework not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: IPromptABFramework with deterministic assignVariant(UserId, ExperimentKey), listExperiments(), configurable traffic splits
missing_implementations.observed: Internal A/B testing in self_improvement_orchestrator.cpp (ABTest class + startABTest/analyzeABTest) is implemented for optimization cycles only; no public IPromptABFramework; no deterministic per-user variant assignment

evidence.stub_note: ABTest is an internal optimization tool, not a public typed framework

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [prompt_engineering] Implement IPromptABFramework with deterministic per-user variant assignment

missing_implementations.title: Automated Quality Regression Interface — IPromptQualityEvaluator not implemented
missing_implementations.expected: IPromptQualityEvaluator with evaluate(IPromptTemplate, QualityConfig) -> QualityReport; stateless, no raw content persistence
missing_implementations.observed: PromptEvaluator is a generic quality scorer; no IPromptQualityEvaluator interface; no regression runner; no QualityReport type

missing_implementations.title: PII Detection & Template Integrity Hash not wired into prompt lifecycle
missing_implementations.expected: PII detection via utils/pii_detector.cpp before LLM transmission; template integrity hash in prompt_version_control.cpp; tenant-scoped A/B experiment context
